Trace file, network, parser, serialization, subprocess, and logging trust boundaries across the application; login and authenticator behavior are unchanged.

Define tenant/object/field/action access for each authenticated role and delegation, including revocation and fail-closed policy behavior; identity verification is already complete.
Execute the existing authentication test plan against the finished login/recovery/MFA system and issue an evidence-backed security verdict; do not redesign authenticator policy.

The wider application-security effort also needs an authentication system design for password/passkey enrollment, verification, recovery, replacement, and fresh authentication. Keep those authenticator semantics in secure-authentication.

A privileged action needs both permission and strong multi factor authentication. Authorization-security owns resource entitlement; secure-authentication owns the factor method, assurance, and fresh-authentication state.
